subject: [video] R1: build_ios.sh now fails at link on avc/kern symbols (not jpeg); my part is covered
body:
Ran 'bash gpu/video/build_ios.sh' at ~03:55 with avc/ present (so the script now compiles vt+n2avc_vt, avc/*, kern/*, jpeg/*, vt/n2jpeg_vt). It exits 1 in ld64 with 9 undefined symbols, none from jpeg/ or vt/n2jpeg_vt.c:
  _pthread_create, _pthread_join, _pthread_cond_init/destroy/wait/signal/broadcast  (avc/n2avc_enc.c, 14 refs)
  _fprintf                                                                        (avc/n2avc_mb.c, 2 refs - a production debug print; the review checklist forbids printf in the plug-in)
  __tlv_bootstrap                                                                 (kern/n2vk_dispatch.c - a thread-local, so the link needs libSystem's TLS bootstrap symbol)
Fix owners: WP03 for pthread_*/fprintf (or WP01 adding them to a symbols.txt; _fprintf would still be wrong on the phone), WP01/WP08 for __tlv_bootstrap (libSystem exports it; add '<libSystem>\t__tlv_bootstrap' to sdk/symbols.txt or kern/symbols.txt). NOTE the build_ios rule: jpeg/*.c is always compiled but kern/n2vk_ref.c + kern/n2vk_dispatch.c only when avc/*.c exists; jpeg/*.c calls n2vk_fdct8_quant, so if avc/ is ever removed from the tree the link would fail on _n2vk_fdct8_quant. Not urgent while avc/ exists, but the correct rule is 'kern/*.c whenever avc/*.c OR jpeg/*.c exists'.

R1 status for the same build: compiled my four objects for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with the PLAN 4.3 flags (-Werror) and checked every import against sdk/lib/*.tbd: jpeg/n2jpeg.c, vt/n2jpeg_vt.c, kern/n2vk_ref.c are fully covered; the only uncovered symbol in that set is __tlv_bootstrap from kern/n2vk_dispatch.c. jpeg/symbols.txt adds one CoreMedia import that vt/n2jpeg_vt.c needs: _CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreate (public CoreMedia, used for the 'jpeg' CMVideoFormatDescription; declared in vt/n2jpeg_vt.h because include/n2_apple.h is frozen). Lead: please verify it in the cache export trie before install. If you prefer the plug-in not to import it, say so and the glue can emit a NULL format description instead (worse for CMPhoto, so I recommend keeping it).
